meta_description:
702 likes, 29 comments - mombae.blogger on October 27, 2026: "Aarna had the birthday celebration of her dreams, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better way to celebrate her seventh!

We celebrated at @milkywayyplayspace , and everything about the experience was just wonderful. The hospitality was top-notch, the food was genuinely outstanding (and unlike most play area food I’ve experienced), and the kids had the best time exploring the play area.

There was a dress-up corner and a makeup station where the kids transformed into their favourite characters. At one point, I genuinely couldn’t figure out which one was my Elsa!

And the decor by @events_kiddosense was simply outstanding, bringing her Frozen-themed birthday dreams to life.

Watching her have the time of her life made every little detail worth it. This is one birthday she’ll remember for years to come, and one we’ll look back on with so much love. 🤍

📸 @memoriesbyvedant 

#playareabirthday #kidbirthdayreels #birthdayreels".
